facts.value: Provides the empty IASA slot for the common GuardSetOff shield-hit reaction, contributing no input-driven cancellation while that reaction is active. GuardSetOff is distinct from GuardOff, the shield-release state; its animation callback selects continued shielding or release after the reaction animation ends.

facts.value: GuardOn advances startup into held Guard while active-shield upkeep updates analog strength and drains health. Release is latched and common arbitration enters GuardOff when its release gate permits. Shield impacts enter common GuardSetOff or Yoshi's separate reaction, with hitlag callbacks and conditional recoil. Timely fresh L/R input selects reflective startup or converts early GuardOn into reflection; independent reflection windows expire only after their decremented counters become negative. Passive depletion invokes shield break only when the resulting shield_health is strictly below zero, then clamps it to zero; exact zero alone does not take that branch.
facts.rationale: Corrects the unit-level exact-zero break claim while preserving the supported lifecycle and exceptional paths.

evidence.why: Strict-negative break, startup progression and release arbitration.

facts.value: When guard.x1C is nonzero, evaluates side special, up special, neutral special, down special, grab, side smash, up smash, down smash, side tilt, up tilt, down tilt and neutral attack in that order. The up-special predicate is canonically named ftCo_Attack100_CheckInput but dispatches ftData_SpecialHi, not rapid jab. The first accepted action skips all later candidates. With x1C zero, or if the entire enabled chain fails, checks neutral escape and then grounded jump. If no predicate accepts a transition, this IASA invocation leaves GuardOff active.
facts.rationale: Corrects the rapid-jab interpretation using canonical callee bodies independently of the rendered SpecialHi hypothesis, and identifies the neighboring SpecialN/SpecialLw dispatches.

evidence.why: Exact x1C gate and priority chain.
Canonical SpecialN, SpecialLw and SpecialHi dispatch tables.

facts.value: Begins the ordinary fighter's GuardOff shield-release phase at animation frame zero. facts.rationale: Preserves the shield-drop-lag mapping while correcting the baseline's unqualified persistence-until-completion claim.
